items.title: ‘Artificial’ Roasts AI’s Creators—and Sends a Dark Warning About Its Dangers
items.summary: From their dorky parties to their weird walks, the movie holds OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and other stakeholders with contempt, while demonstrating their recklessness.
items.author: John Semley

items.title: OpenAI Is Pissing Off a Bunch of Mathematicians—Again
items.summary: “There’s a perception of mobster behavior” from leading AI companies, one mathematician tells WIRED as OpenAI prepares to release more than 100 new solutions to unsolved problems.
items.author: Isabella Ward

items.title: Mistral Says Its New AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Is the Best Open-Weight Offering Outside of China
items.summary: With the release of its new trillion-parameter model, Mistral is hoping to demonstrate it’s “still in the race” to build frontier-level artificial intelligence.
items.author: Joel Khalili

items.title: Kevin Roose Didn’t Use AI to Write His Book About AI
items.summary: The author of The AGI Chronicles says his book “was written by a very tired, overworked, under-slept human being.”
items.author: Katie Drummond
